items.title: Black and gold
items.text: A new look on LG webOS: black pages, gold on what you select, and the tabs written across the top of the screen.

items.title: Lighter and quicker
items.text: Smaller to install, and less for the TV to draw: flat panels instead of blurred glass, so pages move smoothly.

items.title: Beta updates
items.text: Settings, About, Beta updates: try new versions before everyone. Turn it off and only the regular releases come.

items.title: The classic look, any time
items.text: Settings, Appearance, Theme brings back the purple glass whenever you want it.
